item.title: PulseMRR 0.9.19
item.description:
• Where the MRR went. A new card under the headline figures shows the last 30 days as a bridge: the MRR of 30 days ago, new customers, upgrades, customers back, downgrades, cancellations, failed payments, then today's MRR. Rolling 30 days, so it no longer reads 0 on the 1st of the month.
  • Failed payments told apart from cancellations, in the bridge, the movements chart and the revenue churn.
  • Trial conversion now shows how many trials paid, had their card refused, or were cancelled.
  • RevenueCat projects get their own line in the bridge, so it always adds up.
